description: This file is a C header (.h) file containing prototype declarations for internal functions of the CCSP Namespace Component object, related to namespace management within the CCSP platform.

methods.name: CcspNsCompUnregisterNamespace
methods.description: Unregisters a namespace identified by its string name.

methods.name: CcspNsCompGetNamespaceCount
methods.description: Retrieves the total count of namespaces managed by the component.

methods.name: CcspNsCompGetNamespaceStringArray
methods.description: Obtains an array of namespace strings and its size.
parameters: char*** pppNamespace (output: array of namespace strings)

methods.name: CcspNsCompGetNamespaceStructArray
methods.description: Retrieves an array of namespace structures and its size.
parameters: PVOID** ppNamespace (output: array of namespace structures)

methods.name: CcspNsCompBuildFromNamespaceStringArray
methods.description: Builds internal namespace structures from an array of namespace strings.
parameters: char** ppNamespace (input: array of namespace strings)

methods.name: CcspNsCompBuildFromNamespaceStructArray
methods.description: Builds internal namespace structures from an array of namespace structures.
parameters: PVOID* pNamespace (input: array of namespace structures)

methods.name: CcspNsCompIsObjectSupported
methods.description: Checks whether a specific object namespace is supported and optionally checks next level support.

methods.name: CcspNsCompCleanAll
methods.description: Cleans and resets all namespace component internal data.

methods.name: CcspNsCompDumpObject
methods.description: Outputs internal state or information about the namespace component objects for debugging.
